newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Rally leads Bucharest bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Rally leads Bucharest bourse higher.

text.p: First-tier stocks on the Bucharest bourse scored new gains in heavy local and foreign buying on Wednesday, pushing volumes up and sending two independent indices to new year highs.
"Putting the most attractive stocks aside, in a category of their own, was a good idea. They are liquid, they pose fewer risks and they appeal to investors," a trader said.
The rally, extending from last Friday, pushed up the prices of all four high-caps. Fertiliser maker Azomures rose by 120 lei to close at 2,100 lei and Oltchim chemical plant gained 60 lei to 1,460.
Brokers said they expected interest in all four to remain high at the week's last trading session on Thursday, when they said turnover might ease as buy and sell notes had run thinner.
The tier's two pharmaceuticals companies -- Antibiotice and Terapia -- also drifted higher, rising by 100 and 300 lei to 4,100 and 3,650 respectively.
The first tier -- introduced in January -- accounted for more than 88 percent of turnover, which rose to 5.16 billion lei from 4.36 billion.

On the second tier, Policolor dye maker remained the most active. It had a special trade -- a deal scored outside the market and reported to the exchange later -- worth 122.5 million lei. That raised its turnover to 403.18 million and helped it close 100 lei firmer at 2,450.

"Policolor has been quite active in recent sessions and it will stay that way as the chemical sector is appealing to investors," a broker said. "I think it's time it moved on to the first tier," said a broker.
Six of the 30 second-tier listings had no trade and four were suspended pending company announcements.

The VAB and the BIG unofficial indices rose by 4.8 and 4.46 percent respectively from the previous session, hitting year highs for the third session in a row. The BIG first-tier index leapt 4.88 percent to 2,060.35 points.
